thread:
incident-bot: Pager: inference-api service - elevated 5xx rate (>=3% over baseline) in us-east-1. Pagied oncall @olivia at 1787205123

olivia: saw the page, looking now. taking first triage.

ryan: i'm on call backup, can help with customer-impact checks and routing.

olivia: initial quick check - error spike aligns with a large batch job hitting the /v1/generate endpoint. 5xx mainly from model-worker containers OOM'ing.

sarah: tagging infra - autoscaler didn't scale fast enough? i see many pods in CrashLoopBackOff.

luca: looking at k8s events: kubelet evicted pods for memory pressure, node disk also high. moving some pods off affected node group.

olivia: mitigation plan: 1) scale up dedicated pool for inference-api by 3 nodes, 2) enable fallback route to smaller model variant for latency-sensitive customers, 3) disable noncritical background batches. doing in that order.

devon: disabling background batch job (batch-prio-low) now.

incident-bot: Deploy bot: scaling nodegroup 'inference-dedicated-pool' +3 requested by @olivia.

olivia: scaled nodes requested. also added a temporary circuit-breaker rule to limit new long-running generation jobs to 50rps.

ryan: enabling fallback to gpt-medium-quant for premium customers only? suggest fallback tiering: premium->gpt-large, standard->gpt-medium.

evelyn: agreed. implementing fallback policy now. will monitor correctness.

luca: nodes are coming up, pods starting, error rate dropping from 4.8% -> 1.1% in the last 6m.

olivia: good. customer impact: small window (about 8m) of elevated errors for a subset of latency-sensitive requests. no data loss. logging shows retries handled for most requests. I'll open a customer-impact note for Sales/CS.

ryan: thanks. I'll draft a brief message for status.redwood.com and ping CS.

olivia: handing off to @ryan for 30m follow-up and postmortem lead. leaving channel but stay reachable.

ryan: ack, taking handoff. will own the post-incident follow-up.

incident-bot: NOTE: oncall handoff recorded: olivia -> ryan at 1787205400.

ryan: quick postmortem plan: schedule 1-hour review tomorrow 15:00 UTC, invite eng-runtime, eng-sre, infra, product, cs. Drafting agenda: timeline, root cause (eviction + heavy background batch), mitigation steps, long-term fixes, SLO/paging changes.

sarah: long-term fixes we should consider: better eviction handling (node pressure alerts), enforce pod memory requests/limits for batch jobs, and improve node autoscaler thresholds for bursty jobs.

devon: add a short-term change: move batch-prio-low to a separate node pool with nodeSelector to prevent impacting latency-critical pods.

ryan: noted. action items (owner / due):
- "Move batch-prio-low to isolated node pool" / devon / 2026-04-05
- "Add node resource pressure alert and reduce autoscaler cooldown" / luca / 2026-03-22
- "Create fallback routing policy docs + tests" / evelyn / 2026-03-25
- "Customer impact note + status page update" / ryan / 2026-03-16

evelyn: will add tests for fallback logic (unit + integration).

olivia (via DM): quick note - we should revisit SLO paging thresholds. current alert triggers on 1m error rate spikes which causes too many pages for transient noise.

ryan: agree. proposal: change paging policy so that only sustained 5xx > 2% over 5m triggers a page, and 1m spikes create a dashboard alert (no page). also add a heatmap for error distribution by region/model.

luca: example PromQL suggestion for paging rule:```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"inference-api\",status=~\"5..\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"inference-api\"}[5m])) > 0.02
```
This would be the alert expression, with a 2m for eval in Prometheus Alertmanager before sending to PagerDuty.

sarah: also add labels to the alert for model_family, region, and route so we can route pages to the correct owners and avoid noisy cross-team pages.

ryan: good add. we'll update the on-call routing rules: model-owner tags -> routing, and make an override for customer-impacting routes to always page.

devon: quick follow-up: can we add a low-severity "batch saturation" alert that only notifies infra channel (no page) when batch job memory usage > 70% for 10m? helps ops react earlier.

evelyn: yep will add to the alert backlog. I'll own it / due 2026-03-24.

ryan: scheduling: postmortem set for 2026-03-16 15:00 UTC. I've created the calendar invite and added a shared action tracker doc: https://redwood.internal/incident/1787205123/actions (CS/Sales only link).

incident-bot: Postmortem checklist: please attach logs, relevant dashboards, and the timeline before the meeting.

ryan: closing notes: thanks @olivia @luca @devon @evelyn for fast mitigation. We'll capture lessons + update SLO paging rules to reduce noise and improve owner routing. I'll post the preliminary timeline and RCA by EOD.

luca: thanks, monitoring now shows stable <0.5% 5xx. closing pager.

incident-bot: Pager closed at 1787206410.

ryan: (post) action item reminders will be pinged automatically in 48h. please update the tracker when you make progress. :memo:
